newsitem.title: USA: Waban Q3 net up on BJ's operating gains.
newsitem.headline: Waban Q3 net up on BJ's operating gains.

text.p: Waban Inc Tuesday reported a 10.2 percent increase in third quarter, ended October 26, net income on a 34 percent rise in operating income at its BJ's Wholesale Club division.

Operating income of its HomeBase division eased to $12.0 million from $13.4 million last year, reflecting continued weakness in southern California real estate, as well as significant new competition in HomeBase's markets, Waban said.

Third quarter operating income at BJ's rose to $21.3 million from $15.9 million last year, reflecting successful marketing programs, a favorable merchandise mix and the continued development of efficiencies in store level operations, as well as "our growing market presence in selected East Coast markets," Waban said
Waban said its third quarter net rose to $16.0 million, or $0.46 per share, from $14.5 million, or $0.42 per share.

Noting its October 23 announcement of plans to spin off BJ's Wholesale Club to shareholders in 1997, the company said it has discontinued its share repurchase activities, and no shares were repurchased during the third quarter.
